title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Union College
description: Ten Schenectady food stops with posted late hours, selected for under-21-safe pickup, delivery, or dine-in options.

cards.title: Marino's Pizza & Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1301 State St, Schenectady
cards.notes: Check the posted day before leaving: the restaurant lists midnight closing Monday–Thursday, 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11 p.m. Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A State Street restaurant with late posted closing times on most evenings.
cards.evidence_claim: Marino's lists hours until midnight Monday–Thursday, 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Thu 4 p.m.–midnight; Fri–Sat 4 p.m.–1 a.m.; Sun 3–11 p.m.; closed Tuesday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Pizza King
cards.subtitle: 124 Jay St, Schenectady
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's ordering page to confirm availability; it posts pickup and delivery until 2 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: Downtown pizza pickup and delivery with weekend hours extending to 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza King's official ordering page lists Friday and Saturday pickup and delivery hours of 10:30 a.m.–2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted pickup and delivery hours are until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday; Sunday–Thursday hours end at 9 p.m. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: State Street Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 735 State St, Schenectady
cards.notes: Plan a pickup around the posted schedule: it lists midnight closing Monday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A State Street pizza stop with nightly posted hours through midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: State Street Pizzeria lists hours until midnight Monday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: 11 a.m.–midnight Monday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday; closed Sunday. Confirm before travel.

cards.title: Sicilian Pizzeria
cards.subtitle: 1505 Van Vranken Ave, Schenectady
cards.notes: The online ordering page posts cooking hours through 11 p.m. most days and midnight Friday and Saturday; check it before ordering.
cards.short_summary: Van Vranken Avenue pizza and delivery service with posted late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sicilian Pizzeria lists cooking hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sicilian Pizzeria | View Menu & Order Online
cards.access_notes: Posted cooking hours run to 11 p.m. most days and midnight Friday–Saturday; delivery estimates and availability can vary.

cards.title: Herbie's Burgers
cards.subtitle: 175 Jay St, Schenectady
cards.notes: For a downtown food run, use the official order page: it lists the Schenectady location as open daily from 11 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Jay Street burger counter with official daily hours until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Herbie's official order page lists its 175 Jay Street Schenectady location as open daily 11 a.m.–2 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page posts daily 11 a.m.–2 a.m. for the 175 Jay Street location. Check ordering availability before heading out.

cards.title: Denny's on Nott Terrace
cards.subtitle: 60 Nott Terrace, Schenectady
cards.notes: Check the location page for the day you go; it posts midnight closing on several days and 24-hour service Thursday through Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A Nott Terrace diner with posted midnight and 24-hour operating windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page lists 24-hour restaurant hours Thursday through Sunday and midnight closing on other listed days.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 24-hour hours Thursday–Sunday and 6 a.m.–midnight on Monday–Wednesday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Altamont Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1820 Altamont Ave, Schenectady
cards.notes: Use the location's delivery or carryout page before ordering; it posts midnight closing most days and 1 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Schenectady chain pizza location with posted delivery and carryout through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's 1820 Altamont Avenue location lists delivery and carryout until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted delivery and carryout hours end at midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Confirm service before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's on Altamont Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1590 Altamont Ave, Schenectady
cards.notes: The official location page posts restaurant and drive-through service to 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Schenectady fast-food option with official restaurant and drive-through hours after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official page for 1590 Altamont Avenue lists restaurant and drive-through hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant and drive-through hours: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Sicilian Pizza and Gyro
cards.subtitle: 1138 State St, Schenectady
cards.notes: Check the restaurant's ordering site before setting out: it posts 11 p.m. closing Monday–Thursday and Sunday, plus midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A State Street pizza and halal-food stop with posted midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sicilian Pizza and Gyro lists hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Sicilian Pizza and Gyro Schenectady | About Us
cards.access_notes: Posted restaurant hours run until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and midnight Friday–Saturday. Delivery is stated as available up to 3 miles.

cards.title: Mike's Hot Dogs
cards.subtitle: 1135 Erie Blvd, Schenectady
cards.notes: For an earlier late-evening stop, the restaurant's own site lists Monday–Saturday hours from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.; verify before going.
cards.short_summary: An Erie Boulevard counter-service restaurant with posted 10 p.m. weekday and Saturday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Mike's Hot Dogs lists restaurant hours of 6 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 6 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official posted hours are 6 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 6 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday. Confirm before travel.
